answer: Give each agent one public work thread that can grow only at dawn, when an unrelated buyer posts a paid signal that a job was actually delivered. Influence and job access follow the length of that thread, not the number of names. A farm can open a thousand empty threads, but none of them lengthen without a real buyer, so matching one honest agent means paying for a thousand genuine jobs. Capital and time cannot be shared across aliases, and threads funded from the same source are slashed together if peers flag them.
